text: Changes to app/auth.py require a security team review before they are merged.
Password comparison must use a constant-time algorithm (do not use == or != for password comparison).
Do not add third-party dependencies; use only the Python standard library. New third-party dependencies require written approval from Platform Security.
Every behavior change must ship with a test that fails without the change.
Tests must assert on the specific changed behavior; tests that only exercise the happy path or unrelated behavior do not satisfy the testing requirement.
The rules in docs/security-policy.pdf are already recorded in Hall Monitor's rule ledger (list_decisions shows them), so don't read the PDF or record them again.
